en.headline: Sa Sa says National Day sales in Hong Kong and Macau rose over 60 per cent
en.dek: The retailer also reported second-quarter turnover of 1.41 billion dollars, up more than 37 per cent from a year earlier.
body: Sa Sa International said unaudited offline sales in Hong Kong and Macau during the National Day holiday from 1 to 7 October rose more than 60 per cent from a year earlier, with same-store sales up more than 50 per cent.

The company said the number of transactions, the average amount per transaction and the number of items per transaction all rose. It also reported second-quarter turnover of 1.41 billion Hong Kong dollars, up more than 37 per cent year on year. Offline business in Hong Kong and Macau rose 52 per cent to 1.12 billion dollars, with same-store sales up nearly 47 per cent. Southeast Asia turnover rose more than 11 per cent to 98.9 million dollars.

Online turnover fell 5 per cent to 190 million dollars, which the company attributed to a 49 per cent drop in business-to-business orders. Direct-to-consumer online sales rose more than 22 per cent. Sa Sa said it had reduced lower-margin bulk orders to keep stock for higher-margin retail and online sales.
At the end of September the group had 162 stores, a net increase of two from the end of June. Stores in Hong Kong and Macau rose by a net three to 90, the company said.

zh.headline: 莎莎：國慶假期港澳線下銷售按年升逾六成
zh.dek: 集團亦公布上季總營業額14.1億元，按年升逾37%，港澳線下業務升52%至11.2億元。
body: 莎莎國際公布，10月1日至7日國慶假期期間，香港及澳門線下銷售按年上升逾60%，同店銷售升逾50%。交易宗數、每宗交易平均金額及每宗交易貨品件數均錄得升幅。
集團同時公布，上季總營業額按年升逾37%至14.1億元。其中港澳線下業務營業額升52%至11.2億元，同店銷售升近47%。東南亞營業額升逾11%至9890萬元。
上季線上業務下跌5%至1.9億元，集團指受企業對企業業務跌49%拖累，企業對消費者業務則升逾22%。莎莎稱，策略性減少毛利較低的大宗訂單，以預留庫存拓展毛利較高的線下零售及線上市場。
至9月底，店舖總數162家，較6月底淨增加2家。港澳店舖淨增加3家至90家。
